mentions.name: Banned Bookshelf
mentions.description: A directory website listing books that have been banned or pulled from Amazon for being too 'spicy', built as a way to track a topic of interest.
mentions.source_excerpt: One is https://bannedbookshelf.com which lists books that have been banned for whatever reason, or have been yanked off Amazon for being too ‘spicy’.
mentions.author: patrickk
